faq-process-dynamic.title: How to Start Your Journey
faq-process-dynamic.subtitle: A simple, guided process to begin your ACCA or CFA studies with Instil.

processSteps.title: Explore Our Courses
processSteps.description: Review our ACCA, CFA, and CMA US programs to find the right fit for your career goals.

processSteps.title: Choose Your Format
processSteps.description: Select from online, offline, or hybrid learning modes, with the flexibility to swap between them.

processSteps.title: Create Your Account
processSteps.description: Sign up for free to access course details, resources, and personalized guidance from our mentors.

processSteps.title: Begin Learning
processSteps.description: Start your classes with expert instructors focused on building real-world skills and confidence.

about-bio-dynamic.label: About Us
about-bio-dynamic.heading: Mentors, Not Just Instructors
about-bio-dynamic.description: Instil is a premier ACCA and CFA institute founded by four passionate educators dedicated to guiding students to exceptional results.
about-bio-dynamic.storyDescription: Co-founded by educators with over four years of experience, we mentor students to achieve national and global rankings in finance and accounting.
about-bio-dynamic.missionDescription: We empower students with knowledge beyond exams, building confidence and critical thinking for real-world challenges with personalized guidance.
about-bio-dynamic.visionDescription: Promoting a system where individuals are approached for their skills and talent, fostering a learning environment where success is the goal.
